page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, page number at top right. Margin notes in the right margin: Greek notes at the top, a reference beside the text further down, and "Casus 34" beside the start of Sect. III. Gathering signature at the foot left.

main_text.p: Math. c. 5. & 23. apertissimè conflat. Quorum verborum ex utriusque loci collatione is videtur esse scopus, ut dupli-cem (forte an & triplicem) ipsorum errorem corrigeret. Primùm, quòd sibi, modò à Dei nomine abstineretur, in rebus quamvis leviculis, jurandi li-[illegible, ~40 letters]bertatem & παῤῥησίαν[?] quandam concede-rent. Alterum, quòd putarent jurando non peccari, si vel per Deum juraretur, modò verum esset quod juraretur. Tertium, quòd existimarent non esse perju-rium, etsi res falsa juraretur, dum per creaturas id fieret, non autem per Deum. Sic enim illi perperam interpretabantur quod dictum erat, 'Non pejerabis, sed reddes Domino jusjurandum tuum.' Docet itaque Christus Juramenta illa, in quibus [r]ei alicujus creatæ, non item Dei nomen assumitur, non esse propterea aut minùs vere Juramenta, aut minùs obligatoria, quàm illa in quibus per ipsum Deum di-ertim[?] juratur. Et hæc de priore Casu licta[?] funto.
main_text.head: SECT. III.
main_text.p: Casus posterior est, cum per idola aut alsos deos juratur. Pro solutione du-Casus 34[?]

page.notes: Greek marginal notes at the top right (four or five lines beside the first paragraph) are too faint to read reliably and are marked illegible. "Aristoph." is printed as "Ariftoph" and the note "in Avibus" is partly unclear; both are transcribed without certainty. The word "rei" at the start of its line is cut by the left page edge. "di-ertim" is doubtful. "licta funto" is doubtful. The Greek word παῤῥησίαν is doubtful. The "Casus 34" note is partly unclear. The "apertissimè" form is doubtful because the letters are damaged. Long s is printed as s and has been rendered as s throughout.
